About "DiagnosticDoIPTriggerVehicleAnnouncementInterface"
As mentioned in [SWS_DM_00816], the DM is responsible to send the "Vehicle An-
nouncement Message" upon detection of an established link on the network interface.
The mechanism "TriggerVehicleAnnouncement" is foreseen as DM internal functional-
ity, which depends solely on the two scenarios, as defined in the ISO 13400-2:
• send Vehicle Announcement Message on network startup (broadcast to other
IP-based ECUs, Gateways, etc).
• send Vehicle Announcement Message on connection of an external tester (de-
tection of connected IP-based ECUs).
This specification, however, defines a port interface "DiagnosticDoIPTriggerVehicleAn-
nouncementInterface" [SWS_DM_00820], which implies, that an AA could
explicitly
trigger the sending of the "Vehicle Announcement Message". This is not foreseen! An
